breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the instruction to set the end slopes to zero for a simply supported beam was incorrect. The generated specification omits this false constraint and instead provides the correct analytical formula to calculate the slope at the support, which will be a non-zero value. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which also removed the erroneous statement.
